data.rationale: The proposal captures the correct tail of the trip-planning flow (To, date/time, Get trip suggestions, show map) in order, but it omits opening the planner and entering the From location. It also has no parameters, because the destination, date and time are hardcoded ("Plymouth", April 28, the typed hour and minute values are not given), so it couldn't be automated or generalized from the spec alone.
